title: Baby Makeover x Hoffen's Minimal Armor KarateciKagan's Add-on
description: This is a configuration between Baby Makeover and Hoffen's Minimal Armor KarateciKagan's Add-on
body:
I HATE the new baby zombie texture, so I  looked for alternatives. then I found [Baby Makeover](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/baby-makeover) and I liked it! But it wasnt configurable with [Hoffen's Minimal Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hoffens-minimal-armor/versions) and my [Addon](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hoffens-minimal-armor-k.-version). so I decided to change that!

DISCLAIMER: This is an add-on, so if you already dont have the original packs, you need to download them with this too, first reason being it doesnt work properly if you dont and second reason being give the original creators credit

_(If the packs arent working try putting the built-in minecraft pack below this add-on and try putting this addon above the original Hoffen's in the resource packs menu so it takes priority [see gallery for further info])_

Changes from the originals:

-The textures for baby zombies display properly now with baby makeover. 

-The rest of the pack changes are written on the original addon page which you can visit from [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hoffens-minimal-armor-k.-version)

(there is an error with the chestplate texture that baby makeover has that I cant fix [baby zombies shoulder go through the armor texture] if it ever gets fixed I'll update this pack.)
